mapper.insert: INSERT INTO activity_comment_hot (comment_id, comment_hot) VALUES (#{commentId}, 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE comment_hot = comment_hot + 1
mapper.select: SELECT ach.comment_id, ach.comment_hot, ac.user_id, ac.activity_id, ac.content, ac.create_time FROM activity_comment_hot ach INNER JOIN activity_comment ac ON ach.comment_id = ac.id WHERE ac.activity_id = #{activityId} AND ac.deleted = 0 ORDER BY ach.comment_hot DESC
